versions.changelog:
Ark Seedance Video Generation skill initial release:

- Provides end-to-end Volcengine Ark video generation via a Node.js runner and the ARK_API_KEY.
- Handles text-to-video, image-to-video, asset downloads, task polling, task management, and deletion.
- Enforces strict model selection, requiring users to choose one of two approved model IDs before generation.
- Clearly informs users when local media files will be uploaded to Volcengine Ark.
- Ensures workflow steps for input mapping, command execution, output verification, and structured reporting.
